description: Scoring weights used by Aurora and any automated sync scripts to compute priority_score for queue items. Version 1.1 replaces fragile title-string stale-scope detection with the explicit is_stale_scope flag.

rules.reason: Blocking tasks gate all dependent work — highest urgency.
Security posture and pentest readiness directly affect engagement timelines.
Unresolved architecture issues create persistent terminology and design drift across agents and contributors.
Live docs mismatch and stale scope create compound risk when picked up by agents without context. Set explicitly by Aurora — not inferred from title strings.
Decision gates must be elevated so they are not missed by agents scanning the queue.
Items that gate downstream work should be resolved ahead of the work they block.
Blocked items cannot be started — deprioritize in the ranked view.

CRITICAL.note: Must resolve before downstream work. Surface immediately to Aurora and operator.

HIGH.note: Resolve within current sprint or session. Do not leave unassigned.

MEDIUM.note: Resolve this cycle. Safe for agents with appropriate context packs.

LOW.note: Queue for next sprint. Review if it ages past 30 days without progress.

escalation_triggers.action: Escalate to Aurora. Surface on next session open.
Hail operator via PAT. Do not let decision gates go stale silently.

escalation_triggers.condition: new GitHub issue with labels 'security' OR 'blocking'
escalation_triggers.action: Auto-add to queue.json with priority_score >= 30 and state 'decision_required'.
